observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The original photos still only show the lens appearance; they do not show mount/compatibility, autofocus/zoom performance, or any serial/box/battery/charger details.

identity.model: 12-24 mm (wide zoom) for Canon (mount not clearly readable)

claims.claim: US used Sigma 12-24 mm lens for Canon camera.
claims.evidence: Photos show Sigma 12–24 markings, but the Canon mount/compatibility is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: The lens looks new and in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Seller says it was tested, but no functional test evidence (video/AF/zoom test) is provided in photos.
This is a lens; shutter count is a camera metric. No camera body info/screenshot is provided.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the front element but fine fungus/scratches cannot be reliably confirmed from reflections and angle.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: A lens typically does not use a battery/charger; photos do not show any battery/charger or repair documentation.

risks.risk: Wrong mount/compatibility (Canon EF vs other Sigma variants).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens mount side showing contacts + exact mount designation/model code printed on the mount ring (and/or serial/label).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as uncertain Canon compatibility (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Optical defects (fine scratches, haze, fungus) not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear elements under bright light at multiple angles (cap off), plus a short video showing focus through the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed clean (worst-case: minor optical issues).

risks.risk: Functional issues (AF/zoom smoothness, back/front focus) not proven by photos.
risks.proof: Short video test: autofocus lock on a subject + zoom ring movement smoothness, with the camera body visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: assume basic function only).

risks.risk: Credibility mismatch in listing details (shutter count + battery/charger for a lens).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact items included (photos of battery/charger if they exist) and clarification of “shutter count” with the camera body model + screenshot; also request lens serial/box label photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively due to description inconsistency (worst-case: contents/claims not as stated).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the mount side with the exact Canon mount designation/model code (and lens serial/label if available).
Send close-up photos of both front and rear elements (cap off) under bright light from multiple angles.
Send a short video showing autofocus lock and zoom ring operation (camera body visible).
Clarify what “battery and charger” refers to by sending photos of those items (or correct the listing).
Provide the camera body model and a screenshot showing shutter count (or correct the claim).
response.reason: The seller’s insistence doesn’t replace missing evidence. Without new photos/videos showing mount compatibility and functional/optical condition, the key factors that determine price remain unverified, and the “shutter count/battery+charger” claims are inconsistent with a lens listing.
